text: To ensure safety and proper technique, it is essential to follow these steps before engaging in swimming: first, take deep breaths to prepare your lungs for underwater breathing; then, begin by kicking your legs gently for propulsion. As you gain confidence and proficiency, consider gradually increasing the intensity of your stroke, such as transitioning from crawl to butterfly. Remember to swim with the correct breathing pattern: inhale while on the surface and exhale when under water. Always prioritize safety by swimming in a well-lit, clean environment and avoiding excessive heat or cold stress.
